# Vendored assets

- `gsap.min.js` — GSAP 3.13.0 core, from
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js
- `ScrollTrigger.min.js` — GSAP 3.13.0 ScrollTrigger plugin, from
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js

Both are served by this site itself so the page makes no requests to third
parties (see `www/privacy.html`). The GSAP standard "no charge" license
permits self-hosting; the license notice is kept in the file headers.
Update both files together and keep this note in sync.
